notes.title: Small update: Tweaked pamphlet interaction, fixed cursor bugs
notes.content:
Hi all

Changed it so that the trigger for the pamphlet is now a toggle.

Also, hitting the donate box was breaking my UI cursor! Oops. Fixed that.

Cheers,

Finn Sinclair

notes.title: Small update: Migration to 5.5.2, changed pamphlet interaction
notes.content:
Hi all

Just pushed a small update that changes how you grab the pamphlet. Now, you hold onto it with the trigger. Students testing the museum did not understand the grip button system very well.

If this is too much of a hassle, please let me know.

- Finn

tags.feature: Now, you hold onto it with the trigger.

notes.title: The VR Museum of Fine Art: The Second Floor Update
notes.content:
Hi all!

Welcome to the Second Floor! This update has various quality of life improvements, including the Settings and Options Cafe, improved pamphlet interactions, and graphics sliders.

It also includes a plethora of new paintings to enjoy, a elevator, new busts, new sculptures, and a poem.

I hope you all enjoy!

Cheers,

Finn Sinclair

tags.feature: - A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin

notes.title: Hotfix Patch #2: Quality Settings Bug (lighting/shadows)
notes.content: The second hotfix just released, and it fixes a bug where some users were experiencing significantly worse graphics involving missing lighting and missing shadow effects. These issues should now be resolved.

notes.title: Hotfix Update #1: Level of Detail slider
notes.content:
There was an issue with some people's systems where the statues would appear much lower quality than they should! There is now a slider in the lobby that you can use to adjust the levels of LoD that the statues use.

Thanks for your continued interest and support.
